_about: Bear / base / bull scenarios. Each scenario overrides only the assumptions listed. Everything else comes from config/assumptions.json (operating) and config/valuation.json (terminal). WACC is held at the base-case 8.38% in all three, so the scenarios isolate business outcomes; discount-rate risk is covered separately by the WACC grid.

bear.narrative: Consumer slowdown and price competition. Comparable sales fade to 2.5%, member growth slows as openings cannibalize existing warehouses, wage and tariff costs push SG&A up, and Costco invests margin in price to defend traffic. The membership moat erodes, so returns on new investment converge toward peers.

base.narrative: The forecast in config/assumptions.json with terminal growth of 3.0% and RONIC of 25%.

bull.narrative: Traffic and share gains continue. Comparable sales stay near the FY2023-24 ex-gas run-rate, international expansion lifts openings to 30 a year, member growth holds up, and scale plus the co-branded card and e-commerce add modest gross-margin gains. The moat keeps incremental returns near today's ROIC.
